name: Yumeno Owari
source:
Faced with the brink of extinction due to a sudden environmental catastrophe, humanity placed its last hope in a team of android explorers, sent into the depths of space.

Aboard one of these vessels, a single android has traveled alone through the cosmos for twenty long years.

At last, it arrives on an uncharted planet—but what awaits it there is unknown...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3665680/__Upon_the_Dreams_End/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
面对突如其来的环境灾难，人类濒临灭绝，人类将最后的希望寄托在一支被派往太空深处的机器人探险队身上。

在其中一艘飞船上，一个机器人独自在宇宙中旅行了二十年。

最后，它到达了一个未知的星球——但那里等待着它的却是未知的……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3665680/__Upon_the_Dreams_End/]Steam[/url]]
